characters.summary: Etrigan the Demon is a fierce mystic combatant bound to human host Jason Blood. He relies on demonic strength, hellfire projection, and rhyming incantations to overwhelm opponents.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to specific high-level magic and iron in certain continuity versions
Bound to human host Jason Blood
limitations: Transformation depends on the rhyming invocation spoken by or for Jason Blood

sources.supports: General origins, powers, and association with Jason Blood.

feats.claim: Fought evenly against major magical and physical threats in the DC Universe using hellfire and brute strength.

notableResults.note: Brought to a standstill due to magical properties.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses inherent demonic magic and casts rhyming spells.
Casts mystic spells through rhyming incantations.

unknowns: Exact limits of hellfire resistance vary across different creative runs.

characters.summary: Firestorm is a nuclear-powered superhero created by the matrix fusion of two minds. He manipulates atomic structures, transmutes elements, and flies at high speeds.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to disruptions of the Firestorm matrix
Mental coordination required between fused minds
limitations: Requires active cooperation of both minds in the matrix to operate at full capacity

sources.supports: Atomic transmutation, nuclear powers, and dual-mind fusion.

feats.claim: Transmuted a mountain of concrete into harmless snow.

campaignTags.claim: Flies through atomic manipulation and energy propulsion.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of mass transmutation without fatigue.

characters.summary: General Zod is a Kryptonian military leader with all the standard powers of a Kryptonian under a yellow sun. He fights with ruthless tactical precision and advanced combat training.
limitations: Powers completely depend on yellow sun radiation and oxygen

sources.supports: Kryptonian physiology under yellow sun, military background, and powers.

feats.claim: Fought Superman to a standstill using superior military training and equivalent Kryptonian power.

notableResults.note: Evenly matched in raw physical statistics.

campaignTags.claim: Flies using Kryptonian physiology under a yellow sun.

unknowns: Vulnerability to magic remains consistent with standard Kryptonian baselines.

characters.summary: Giganta possesses the ability to dramatically increase her physical size and mass, granting her immense superhuman strength and durability in giant form.

mechanisms: Increased durability and mass while giant

weaknesses: Vulnerable to mental attacks and specialized anti-metahuman restraints
limitations: Size-change has upper boundaries and requires concentration

sources.supports: Size-changing powers, origin, and combat style.

feats.claim: Grew to giant size and lifted a full city bus to hurl at Wonder Woman.

notableResults.note: Defeated by Wonder Woman's superior combat skill and lasso.

campaignTags.claim: Can grow from normal human size into a towering giant.
Attains heights well over 20 feet when utilizing size-change.

unknowns: Exact maximum height limit in modern continuity revisions.

limitations: Telepathy requires line of sight or focused concentration for complex control

sources.supports: Telepathy, super-intelligence, strength, and Gorilla City origins.

feats.claim: Mentally dominated an entire stadium of spectators simultaneously.

notableResults.note: Overcome by Flash's speed despite telepathic traps.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses powerful telepathic mind control and reading abilities.
Can dominate the minds of humans and animals.

unknowns: Full extent of telepathic reach across planetary distances.

characters.summary: Green Arrow is a master archer and martial artist utilizing a wide array of trick arrows and tactical acumen to combat street and global-level threats.
limitations: Limited quiver capacity requiring tactical conservation

sources.supports: Archery mastery, trick arrows, and peak human status.

feats.claim: Shot an arrow through the barrel of a fired gun from a distance.

notableResults.note: Overcame vertigo induction with special countermeasures and skill.

campaignTags.claim: Uses specialized trick arrows containing high-tech payloads.

unknowns: Effectiveness of specialized arrows against heavy cosmic armor.

characters.summary: Hal Jordan wields a Green Lantern power ring fueled by willpower, enabling him to construct hard-light objects, fly at interstellar speeds, and project intense energy beams.
weaknesses: Ring charge dependent on wearer's willpower and 24-hour battery recharge
Historical vulnerability to yellow color in older continuity
mobility: Interstellar teleportation / light-speed travel via ring
limitations: Ring requires periodic recharging via power battery

sources.supports: Power ring capabilities, willpower scaling, and construct generation.

feats.claim: Constructed a giant working fighter jet complex to intercept airborne missiles.

notableResults.note: Defeated Sinestro in direct ring duel.

conditional.ability: Hard-light construct generation and energy projection
conditional.dependsOn: Green Lantern Power Ring and Lantern Battery charge

campaignTags.claim: Flies at hyper-luminal speeds through power ring propulsion.

unknowns: Exact limits of willpower endurance under extreme psychological torture.

characters.summary: Hal Jordan bound to the Spectre serves as the Wrath of God, wielding supreme divine magic, omnipotent reality-altering judgment, and boundless cosmic authority.

mechanisms: Invulnerability to conventional physical and energy attacks

weaknesses: Bound by divine rules and the need for a worthy human host
Susceptible to high-level cosmic magic or divine intervention
limitations: Subject to the Presence and cosmic laws governing the Wrath of God
characters.formDifferences: Replaces the Green Lantern ring with the boundless divine authority and wrath of the Spectre.

sources.supports: Spectre host bond with Hal Jordan, divine wrath powers.

notableResults.note: Defeated the rogue angel Asmodel through divine judgment.

conditional.ability: Omnipotent divine judgment and reality control

campaignTags.claim: Wields supreme divine magic as the Wrath of God.
Channels divine decrees and cosmic judgments.

unknowns: Exact limitations imposed by divine mandate during combat.
